design.decision: Bid higher on [A]-rich hands instead of bidding safe.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first [A] win; big contracts draw aggressive defense.
design.rationale: A bid-tension Ranks payoff so [A] builds don't push toward safe bids; scaling plus a trigger is a deliberate departure for the bid-tension target.

critic.concerns: Event count times contract size is hard to estimate at bid time; same bid-tension departure as ca-diamond-lead-contract and ca-trump-contract, so likely only one of the three earns its clause.
